title: AREX: Towards a Recursively Self-Improving Agent for Deep Research
task: Recursively self-improving deep research agent with constraint verification
key_results: AREX outperforms comparable-scale baselines on BrowseComp, WideSearch, DeepSearchQA, and Humanity's Last Exam; 122B MoE model remains competitive with substantially larger models
comments: The recursive verify-refine loop is intuitive, but long-horizon learning stability and the dense reward engineering (emphasizing key decision steps) suggest the approach may be sensitive to task structure.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Discovery-verification asymmetry enables more efficient research through constraint-wise auditing rather than pure search extension
hypotheses.result: AREX's recursive self-improvement loop substantially outperforms baselines, validating the approach

title: ReferTrack: Referring Then Tracking for Embodied Visual Tracking
task: Embodied visual tracking via referring-then-tracking with grounded bounding boxes
key_results: 89.4%, 73.3%, 74.1% success rates on single-target, distracted, and ambiguity splits; matches multi-camera baselines on EVT-Bench with single forward-facing camera
comments: Temporal-viewpoint-bbox indicators are a clever way to inject motion cues, and sim-to-real transfer on legged robots is impressive, though limited to one camera may struggle with severe occlusions.

model_io.model: Vision-language-action (VLA) transformer with temporal TVBI tokens
inputs: sliding window of previous bounding boxes

hypotheses.hypothesis: Explicit image-space target selection with TVBI temporal cues improves tracking over abstract CoT reasoning in latent space
hypotheses.result: ReferTrack achieves state-of-the-art single-view performance, matching multi-camera baselines on identification-heavy tasks

title: K12-KGraph: A Curriculum-Aligned Knowledge Graph for Benchmarking and Training Educational LLMs
task: Evaluating curriculum cognition in educational LLMs via knowledge graphs
key_results: Gemini-3-Flash achieves 57% exact match, Gemma-4-31B-IT 46%; K12-Train-Text outperforms eight mainstream corpora on matched budget; K12-Train-Full best on Gaokao-MM and MDK12-medium
comments: The curriculum-aligned construction from official textbooks is valuable, but exact-match evaluation on multi-select QA may be overly strict; combining text and visual supervision is sensible but not surprising.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Domain-specific curriculum-aligned training data more effectively improves LLM understanding of prerequisite chains and concept taxonomies than generic instruction-tuning
hypotheses.result: K12-Train-Text consistently outperforms mainstream corpora; K12-Train-Full combining text and visual supervision achieves best overall results

title: Visual Contrastive Self-Distillation
task: Vision-language model self-distillation via content-erased visual contrast
key_results: Qwen3-VL: 62.27%→67.04% at 2B, 71.30%→73.16% at 4B, 72.51%→76.26% at 8B on ViRL39K benchmark aggregate
comments: The core idea of contrasting original-image vs. content-erased distributions is elegant and avoids external teachers; however, the method assumes content erasure cleanly isolates visual signal without removing structural information.

model_io.model: EMA teacher and student vision-language transformers (Qwen3-VL, Qwen3.5)

hypotheses.hypothesis: On-policy self-distillation driven by image-content removal contrast provides stronger learning signal than standard OPSD without external supervision
hypotheses.result: VCSD outperforms matched OPSD baselines across model scales without external teacher, privileged answers, or additional inference cost

title: Show, Don't Tell: Evaluating Spatial Cognition in Generative Pixels Rather Than LLM Text
task: Evaluating spatial cognition in image-generation models via pixel-space answers
key_results: Image-generation models competitive with text-output VLMs in pixel-space expression on ProVisE; text-output VLMs retain advantage in compositional reasoning; validated on six external spatial benchmarks
comments: ProVisE's protocol-based parsing is pragmatic, but converting text coordinates to pixel-space markup introduces its own interface mismatches; results suggest complementary rather than comparable strengths.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Image-generation models excel in direct pixel-space spatial expression while text-output VLMs maintain advantage in compositional spatial reasoning
hypotheses.result: Under unified evaluation, image-generation models show competitive performance in pixel-based answers; text-VLMs superior in compositional tasks across six external benchmarks

title: NVIDIA-labs OO Agents: Native Python Object-Oriented Agents
task: Python object-oriented programming model for building reliable LLM agents
key_results: Strong performance on SWE-bench Verified and Terminal-Bench 2.0; demonstrates six model-facing ideas in unified interface
comments: Treating agents as Python objects is pragmatic and aligns with standard software engineering; however, no quantitative results are reported, making claims of effectiveness difficult to verify.

model_io.model: Model-agnostic (demonstrates with LLMs via agent loop)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Unified agent-as-object programming model enables both developers and LLMs to share the same interface, improving testability and refactorability
hypotheses.result: Current models use NOOA interface effectively on benchmarks; community converging on six identified model-facing ideas (typed I/O, pass-by-reference, code as action, etc.)

title: Tencent WorkBuddy Bench: A Multi-Domain Coding-Agent Benchmark with Contamination-Resistant Task Construction
task: Multi-domain coding-agent benchmarking with contamination-resistant task construction
key_results: Cross-model leaderboard across Code, Web, Office, and Security domains; open-release framework enables end-to-end reproducibility and auditability
comments: Reverse-engineering from real commits/PRs and rewriting as colloquial requests is a good contamination-resistance strategy; four-domain diversity is valuable but no unified scoring limits comparative analysis.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Task prompts reverse-engineered from real commits and rewritten colloquially resist contamination better than adapted public issue text
hypotheses.result: Open-release dataset with versioning and auditability enables reproducible end-to-end benchmarking without reliance on secrecy

title: Color Pass-Through via Camera-Display Coupling
task: End-to-end camera-display color calibration via coupled optimization
key_results: +2.0 points on 5-point user study; >2x improvement on quantitative metrics vs. baselines
comments: Treating camera and display as a coupled system is sensible, but the paper lacks detail on what quantitative metrics are used and whether 2x improvement scales to various display technologies.

model_io.model: End-to-end learned neural network (architecture not specified)

hypotheses.hypothesis: End-to-end coupled camera-display optimization outperforms separate sequential calibration by avoiding low-dimensional color-transform bottlenecks
hypotheses.result: Color Pass-Through achieves +2.0 point user preference improvement and 2x quantitative metric gain vs. baselines

title: LLMs Get Lost in Evolving User Intent
task: Tracking LLM performance under dynamic, evolving user intent across multi-turn conversations
key_results: Substantial performance drops across model families when intent evolves; strong static-setting performance does not transfer to dynamic settings
comments: The finding that LLMs struggle with evolving intent is important and somewhat counterintuitive; however, the framework simply transforms existing tasks without creating new data, limiting granularity in understanding failure modes.

inputs: multi-turn user messages with evolving intent

hypotheses.hypothesis: LLMs evaluated in static, fully-specified settings do not faithfully track or act on evolving user intent in multi-turn conversations
hypotheses.result: Consistent performance drops across model families when intent evolves; static-setting performance does not transfer to dynamic-intent setting

title: SANA-Video 2.0: Hybrid Linear Attention with Attention Residuals for Efficient Video Generation
task: Efficient high-resolution video generation via hybrid linear-softmax attention and attention residuals
key_results: VBench score 84.30 in 13.2s at 480p on single H100; 3.2x faster than matched softmax baseline at 720p/60s; 120x faster than Wan 2.2-A14B at 720p
comments: Hybrid attention (3:1 linear-to-softmax ratio) and attention residuals for rank restoration are well-motivated; the 25% softmax optimal trade-off is surprisingly low, suggesting careful tuning.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Hybrid linear-softmax attention with attention residuals matches full-softmax quality at substantially reduced computational cost via O(N) scaling
hypotheses.result: SANA-Video 2.0 achieves softmax-level quality with 3.2x speedup at 720p and 120x speedup vs. larger baselines; 25% softmax optimal trade-off

title: Self-Supervised Learning of Structured Dynamics from Videos
task: Learning structured motion decomposition (camera vs. object motion) from video using self-supervision
key_results: SDM outperforms backbone baselines on ProbeMotion; compares favorably to strongly supervised VGGT despite weaker supervision
comments: Decomposing camera and object motion is well-motivated, but the evaluation is limited to synthetic and simple real videos; unclear how well structured dynamics transfer to downstream tasks.

model_io.model: Structured Dynamics Model on frozen pretrained ViT features
inputs: future frames (synthetic Kubric or real video)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Pretrained image ViTs can recover structured motion decomposition (camera vs. object) via future-feature prediction with weak synthetic supervision
hypotheses.result: SDM outperforms CLS/pooled baselines and compares favorably to fully supervised representations on ProbeMotion evaluation suite

title: Streaming Multi-Agent Autoregressive Diffusion Model with World State Registers
task: Multi-agent video diffusion with explicit world state registers across agents and views
key_results: World-state modeling improves logical consistency and generation quality in two-agent Minecraft video generation; outperforms observation-history-only baselines
comments: Explicit world-state registers are intuitive for multi-agent consistency, but evaluation is limited to Minecraft; generalization to real-world or photorealistic multi-agent scenarios is unclear.

model_io.model: Streaming multi-agent autoregressive diffusion with Mixture-of-Transformers
inputs: global state views including bird's-eye view

hypotheses.hypothesis: Explicit cross-agent world-state registers with supervision from agent status and global views improve consistency vs. observation-history conditioning
hypotheses.result: WorldWeaver improves logical consistency and generation quality; Mixture-of-Transformers design separates world-state and visual modeling effectively

title: Robostral Navigate
task: Scalable monocular navigation for embodied agents across robot embodiments via waypoint prediction
key_results: R2R-CE: 77.4% success (10.5 pts above monocular, 5.3 pts above multi-camera baselines); RxR-CE: 75.1% success
comments: Image-space waypoint prediction naturally handles camera/scale variation, enabling embodiment-agnostic deployment; 2.4M trajectories from 350k scenes and prefix-caching training (22x token reduction) are strong engineering contributions.

model_io.model: 8B vision-language model with prefix-caching and tree-based attention masking

hypotheses.hypothesis: Image-space waypoint prediction from monocular RGB naturally generalizes across embodiments and camera intrinsics without recalibration
hypotheses.result: Robostral Navigate achieves 77.4% on R2R-CE, exceeding monocular and depth/multi-camera baselines; scales to wheeled, legged, and aerial robots

title: Predictive Divergence Masks for LLM RL
task: Trust-region masking for LLM RL using divergence-based direction criterion
key_results: Divergence-based direction criterion aligns better with realized divergence change than sampled-ratio masks; improved RL training across model scales and precision settings
comments: Replacing sampled-ratio direction criterion with predicted divergence change is theoretically motivated; however, no absolute performance numbers (e.g., reward gains) are provided, limiting impact assessment.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Predictive divergence masks based on closed-form divergence change prediction outperform sampled-ratio direction criterion in aligning with actual divergence dynamics
hypotheses.result: Divergence-based direction criterion shows better alignment with realized divergence change; improves RL training across model scales and precision

title: Sample-Efficient Learning from Agent Experience
task: In-context learning distillation for agents without additional environment interactions
key_results: Experience Distillation retains 64.8% of in-context learning gains; 3.8% recovery for direct SFT; matches RL baselines with 9.6x fewer environment samples
comments: The distinction between in-context learning and experience distillation is useful; however, 64.8% retention suggests meaningful information loss, and applicability beyond software engineering and text adventures is unclear.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Context distillation can internalize agent experience into model weights while preserving most in-context learning gains without additional environment interaction
hypotheses.result: Experience Distillation retains 64.8% of in-context gains vs. 3.8% for direct SFT; matches RL with 9.6x fewer samples across software engineering and text-adventure domains

title: Multi-Turn On-Policy Distillation with Prefix Replay
task: Off-policy distillation for multi-turn agents via replayed-prefix supervision
key_results: ReOPD preserves or improves OPD-level accuracy; uses zero tool calls during student training; 4x faster per rollout than OPD
comments: Reusing teacher trajectories as prefixes avoids expensive online rollouts; the prefix-trap insight (student occupancy vs. teacher reliability trade-off) is valuable, though step-decay schedule is relatively simple.

model_io.model: Teacher and student LLMs for multi-turn agentic tasks
outputs: student action predictions with dense per-step supervision

hypotheses.hypothesis: Replayed-prefix on-policy distillation with reliability-aware prefix distribution addresses the prefix trap (student occupancy vs. teacher reliability) in multi-turn OPD
hypotheses.result: ReOPD preserves OPD-level accuracy with zero tool calls during training and 4x speedup vs. fully online OPD; matches RL baselines across reasoning and search environments

title: Recurrent Sinusoidal INRs for Efficient High-Fidelity Representation
task: Efficient implicit neural representation via sinusoidal recurrence for harmonic spectral enrichment
key_results: Higher fidelity than feed-forward baselines with fewer parameters and optimization steps; favorable transfer to super-resolution, NeRF, SDF tasks
comments: Sinusoidal recurrence for spectral enrichment is theoretically motivated, but no quantitative benchmarks (PSNR, SSIM) are provided; comparison with recent INR methods is limited.

model_io.model: Recurrent sinusoidal INR with shared block and iterative refinement
outputs: RGB value or implicit field value

hypotheses.hypothesis: Sinusoidal recurrence iteratively enriches harmonic spectral support more efficiently than feed-forward expansion
hypotheses.result: Proposed method achieves higher fidelity than baselines with fewer parameters and fewer optimization steps; transfers favorably to super-resolution and NeRF tasks

title: TableVerse: A Large-scale Tabletop Dataset with Real-world Grounded Layouts for Generalizable Manipulation
task: Large-scale tabletop object manipulation dataset via Real2Sim from internet images
key_results: TableVerse-100K: 100,000 unique physically consistent environments with collision-free demonstrations; automated pipeline ensures metric scale accuracy and mechanical stability
comments: Automated Real2Sim from unstructured internet images is impressive; however, no downstream task performance results are reported, making utility for generalization claims unverified.

model_io.model: Real2Sim pipeline and task-conditioned trajectory generation
inputs: unstructured internet image of tabletop scene

hypotheses.hypothesis: Real2Sim reconstruction from internet images with automated trajectory generation scales tabletop manipulation data while preserving real-world plausibility
hypotheses.result: TableVerse-100K dataset provides 100,000 physically consistent, diverse environments; potential to enable generalizable manipulation learning (downstream evaluation pending)

title: FinanceComplexQA: Benchmarking Agentic Reasoning on Industrial-grade Financial Documents
task: Comprehensive financial QA benchmark with complex layouts and agentic reasoning evaluation
key_results: 2,026 deep research tasks on 1,009 financial documents; bilingual support; benchmarks RAG systems and agentic tools; identifies failure cases in numerical, multi-hop, summarization, and industry analysis
comments: Professional financial documents and expert-curated QA pairs are valuable; however, the Agent-as-Judge evaluation may reflect model biases rather than ground truth, especially for open-ended generation.

model_io.model: RAG systems and agentic reasoning tools (GPT-4, various LLMs)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Complex financial documents with diverse layouts and multi-hop reasoning requirements reveal limitations of RAG and agentic tools in numerical computation and industry analysis
hypotheses.result: FinanceComplexQA evaluation identifies significant performance variation across agents; key failure modes in numerical, multi-hop, and industry-analysis tasks

title: GraphVid: Interactive Graph-Controllable Video Generation
task: Interactive controllable video generation via structured interaction graphs
key_results: FID ↓39.9%, FVD ↓37.6% vs. Motion-I2V; PSNR 9.87→15.98, SSIM 0.38→0.61; fewer parameters and less training data than baselines
comments: Graph-based interaction specification is more explicit than trajectory-based control; however, requiring ground-truth structured annotations at train/test time may limit practical adoption.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Structured interaction graphs enable more precise multi-object control than trajectory-based or text-only conditioning in video generation
hypotheses.result: GraphVid outperforms Motion-I2V substantially (FID -39.9%, FVD -37.6%) with fewer parameters and less training data; curated GraphVid-Bench enables interaction-aware training

title: Dataset Distillation by Influence Matching
task: Dataset distillation via influence matching
key_results: Tiny-ImageNet (IPC=10): 31.5% accuracy (+4.7% over NCFM); Flickr30K vision-language: +2.5% average over NCFM on image/text retrieval
comments: The linear-time influence estimator via Taylor approximation is elegant, but relies on first-order assumptions that may limit accuracy for highly non-convex losses.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Aligning final training outcomes (via influence) outperforms aligning per-step gradients or trajectories
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: Inf-Match achieves best accuracy on standard classification and vision-language benchmarks

hypotheses.hypothesis: Sample-level influence can be estimated efficiently without inverse-Hessian in linear time
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: Linear-time estimator via first-order Taylor approximation of unrolled optimization dynamics

title: Computer experimentation reveals mechanisms for signaling and coupled transport that trade efficiency for robust growth
task: Determine mechanism of membrane potential-driven ammonium transport in E. coli
key_results: Electro-binding models 28-fold more plausible than electro-flipping models; membrane potential affects AmtB-NH4+ binding from cytoplasmic side
comments: Computational approach successfully disambiguates between mechanistic hypotheses by comparing kinetic models to experimental data, though experimental validation of the proposed spatiotemporal mechanism would strengthen conclusions.

model_io.model: Six kinetic models of E. coli ammonium transport (3 electro-binding, 3 electro-flipping)
Integrated kinetic-thermodynamic model with GS regulation

hypotheses.hypothesis: Membrane potential drives ammonium transport via electro-binding (affecting NH4+ binding affinity)
hypotheses.result: Supported; 28-fold higher plausibility than electro-flipping mechanism

hypotheses.hypothesis: Membrane potential acts on binding from cytoplasmic side of AmtB
hypotheses.result: Supported by kinetic model analysis and structural integration

hypotheses.hypothesis: Coordinated GS-AmtB regulation minimizes futile cycling while maintaining rapid growth
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; simulations show this regulatory strategy balances efficiency and robustness under ammonium limitation

title: RON receptor tyrosine kinase regulates abiraterone resistance in prostate cancer via the methylation-dependent and independent dual functions of DNMT1
task: Elucidate dual functions of DNMT1 in RON-mediated abiraterone resistance in prostate cancer
key_results: RON expression increased in abiraterone-insensitive tumors; RON-mediated DNMT1 methyltransferase activity inhibits RIPK3 expression reducing cell death; RON-driven DNMT1 non-methyltransferase activity alters mitochondrial function enhancing migration; BMS-777607+abiraterone suppresses tumor growth and invasion
comments: The identification of DNMT1 as a functional hub for both survival (methyltransferase) and migration (non-methyltransferase) activities reveals unexpected complexity in epigenetic regulation of cancer resistance.

model_io.model: Prostate cancer cell lines and xenograft tumors

hypotheses.hypothesis: RON-mediated abiraterone resistance acts through a single DNMT1-dependent pathway
hypotheses.result: Rejected; RON uses dual methyltransferase-dependent (RIPK3 inhibition) and non-methyltransferase-dependent (mitochondrial dysfunction) DNMT1 functions

hypotheses.hypothesis: RON inhibition combined with abiraterone suppresses resistant tumor growth
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; BMS-777607+abiraterone suppresses both proliferation and metastasis in abiraterone-resistant xenografts

title: Matrix stiffness promotes colorectal cancer progression via Golgi-dependent cholesterol synthesis
task: Elucidate the mechano-metabolic pathway linking matrix stiffness to cholesterol-driven cancer progression
key_results: Matrix stiffness activates Piezo1→Golgi-ER reorganization→SREBP2-driven HMGCR upregulation; HMGCR-mediated cholesterol accumulation promotes β-catenin phosphorylation at Ser552, disrupting adherens junctions and driving EMT
comments: The coupling of biomechanical sensing to metabolic reprogramming through organelle remodeling is mechanistically sophisticated and identifies a novel therapeutic combination target.

model_io.model: Colorectal cancer cells on stiff matrices

hypotheses.hypothesis: Matrix stiffness directly upregulates cholesterol synthesis independent of mechanotransduction
hypotheses.result: Rejected; stiffness requires Piezo1-mediated Ca²⁺ signaling and Golgi-ER reorganization

hypotheses.hypothesis: HMGCR-mediated cholesterol accumulation drives EMT through β-catenin-mediated junctional disassembly
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; cholesterol promotes β-catenin Ser552 phosphorylation, disrupting E-cadherin complexes and enabling nuclear β-catenin accumulation

title: CDC7 and APC/CCdh1 gate distinct routes to initiate DNA replication
task: Determine how cells trigger origin firing and initiate DNA replication
key_results: Origin firing requires a tunable CDK2/1 threshold gated by either CDC7 or APC/CCdh1; CDC7 enables firing at low CDK2/1 activity while APC/CCdh1 inactivation requires much higher CDK2/1 activity
comments: The discovery of two distinct gating routes provides mechanistic insight into why simultaneously blocking both CDC7 and APC/CCdh1 inactivation is necessary to prevent S phase entry.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Origins fire at fixed thresholds of cell cycle regulators
hypotheses.result: Rejected; firing is triggered at tunable CDK2/1 thresholds gated by CDC7 or APC/CCdh1

hypotheses.hypothesis: CDC7 and APC/CCdh1 provide alternative routes to origin firing
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; CDC7 phosphorylates MCM for Cyclin E-CDK2 firing; APC/CCdh1 inactivation enables Cyclin A-CDK1 phosphorylation of MCM at distinct sites

title: Structural insights into ligand recognition and activation of the human oxoglutarate receptor OXGR1
task: Determine structural basis of ligand recognition and activation of the metabolite-sensing GPCR OXGR1
key_results: Cryo-EM structures reveal α-ketoglutarate and itaconate binding interactions with OXGR1; pH-dependent regulation with maximal activity at physiological pH 7.4; structure-activity relationship identifies determinants of metabolite specificity
comments: The structural framework enables rational drug design, though pH-dependent regulation adds complexity for therapeutic targeting of OXGR1-associated disorders.

hypotheses.hypothesis: OXGR1 recognizes α-ketoglutarate and itaconate through distinct binding mechanisms
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; structure-activity relationship reveals carbon chain length, functional groups, and spatial configuration determine ligand specificity

hypotheses.hypothesis: OXGR1 activity is constitutive regardless of pH
hypotheses.result: Rejected; pH-dependent regulatory mechanism with maximal activity at physiological pH 7.4

title: IFI208, an interferon-stimulated gene, promotes host antiviral responses through liquid-liquid phase separation of MDA5
task: Elucidate the role of IFI208 in antiviral innate immune responses
key_results: IFI208 enhances MDA5-mediated dsRNA recognition and promotes its oligomerization through liquid-liquid phase separation; XPO1-IFI208-MDA5 axis increases type I interferon production
comments: The finding that a PYHIN family member lacking the canonical HIN domain promotes phase separation of pattern recognition receptors suggests functional diversification beyond nucleic acid sensing.

hypotheses.hypothesis: IFI208 functions as a viral nucleic acid sensor through a HIN domain
hypotheses.result: Rejected; IFI208 lacks HIN domain but functions as an interferon-stimulated gene enhancing MDA5 activity

hypotheses.hypothesis: IFI208 promotes MDA5-mediated antiviral responses through phase separation
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; IFI208 interacts with MDA5 to enhance dsRNA recognition and promote its oligomerization via liquid-liquid phase separation

title: FOSL2-driven SASP in endometrial stroma promotes the inflammation of endometriosis
task: Determine the role of FOSL2-driven senescence-associated secretory phenotype in endometriosis-associated pelvic inflammation
key_results: FOSL2 aberrantly overexpressed in endometrial stromal cells (ESCs) marked by SASP; FOSL2 overexpression induces cellular senescence and SASP factor secretion; FOSL2 regulated by PGE2/cAMP/PKA signaling and modulates SASP through NF-κB activation
comments: The identification of FOSL2-driven SASP as a driver of chronic inflammation in endometriosis offers a tractable therapeutic target, though the upstream triggers of FOSL2 overexpression remain unclear.

model_io.model: Endometrial stromal cells from endometriosis patients

hypotheses.hypothesis: FOSL2 overexpression induces cellular senescence and SASP in endometrial stromal cells
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; FOSL2 knockdown reverses senescence and SASP factor secretion

hypotheses.hypothesis: FOSL2-driven SASP modulates immune responses through M2 macrophage polarization
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; conditioned medium from high-FOSL2 ESCs promotes M2 macrophage polarization and recruitment

title: The blood proteome predicts the impact of circulating factors on age-related mitochondrial health
task: Identify circulating proteomic factors associated with age-related mitochondrial dysfunction
key_results: 25-protein MitoAge signature predicts age-related mitochondrial bioenergetic capacity decline; serum-induced mitochondrial capacity negatively correlates with donor chronological and epigenetic age
comments: Using elastic net regression to derive mechanistically-informed biomarkers of aging is promising, though the signature requires validation in independent cohorts.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Circulating factors contribute to age-related mitochondrial bioenergetic decline
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; maximal mitochondrial capacity negatively correlates with donor chronological and epigenetic age

hypotheses.hypothesis: A proteomic signature can predict age-related mitochondrial health status
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; MitoAge 25-protein signature predicts systemic bioenergetic effects and physical function differences in human aging

title: Royal jelly ameliorates age-associated stem cell dysfunction with Chi3l1-mediated increase in CD206-positive macrophages
task: Determine how Royal Jelly enhances age-associated stem cell dysfunction through Chi3l1-mediated macrophage polarization
key_results: Royal Jelly administration increases stem/progenitor cell proliferation in aged skin and brain with improved hair phenotypes and enhanced neurogenesis; Chi3l1 identified as RJ-responsive gene downregulated in senescence; Chi3l1 required for maintaining hepatic CD206-positive macrophages
comments: The work elegantly demonstrates that food-derived compounds can modulate aging phenotypes through immunometabolic mechanisms, though causality in vivo relies on genetic disruption in liver tissue.

model_io.model: Aged mice treated with Royal Jelly; human mesenchymal stem/stromal cells

hypotheses.hypothesis: Royal Jelly enhances stem cell activity through Chi3l1-mediated immune remodeling
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; RJ upregulates Chi3l1, which maintains CD206-positive macrophages required for stem/progenitor cell activity

hypotheses.hypothesis: Chi3l1 is primarily a pathogenic pro-inflammatory factor in aging
hypotheses.result: Rejected; Chi3l1 functions as a physiologically regulated immune mediator supporting stem cell maintenance

title: Mitochondrial tRNA biogenesis, modifications and disease relevance
task: Review mitochondrial tRNA biogenesis, modifications, and disease relevance as a comprehensive synthesis
key_results: mt-tRNA structures severely degenerated through evolution; mt-tRNA maturation requires coordinated actions of mitochondrial processing enzymes; post-transcriptional modifications stabilize structure and support streamlined genetic code; mt-tRNA-associated pathologies linked to multiple diseases with emerging therapeutic strategies
comments: This comprehensive review synthesizes progress in understanding how domesticated organellar translation machinery maintains fidelity despite genetic code compression, providing unified principles for therapeutic intervention.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Degenerated mt-tRNA structures impair their function independent of post-transcriptional modifications
hypotheses.result: Rejected; post-transcriptional modifications and coevolved mt-tRNA-associated proteins compensate for structural degeneration

hypotheses.hypothesis: mt-tRNA pathologies reflect universal principles of translation fidelity that inform therapeutic strategies
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; review identifies unifying principles linking mt-tRNA biogenesis, modifications, and disease mechanisms

title: Enhanced HGF with increased receptor affinity and nitration-dysfunction resistance through interaction with lipoic acid trisulfide
task: Enhance HGF receptor-binding affinity and nitration resistance through interaction with lipoic acid trisulfide
key_results: LASSS interaction increases HGF c-met binding affinity >2-fold; LASSS confers nitration resistance particularly for Y198; pre-administration prevents disuse-induced HGF nitration in tail-suspension model
comments: The non-antioxidative mechanism of LASSS-mediated nitration resistance is novel and may represent a broader principle for post-translational protein enhancement.

model_io.model: HGF-c-met signaling in myogenic cells and mice

hypotheses.hypothesis: LASSS enhances HGF function through antioxidative mechanisms
hypotheses.result: Rejected; glutathione trisulfide (antioxidant) and lipoic acid alone do not enhance binding or confer nitration resistance

hypotheses.hypothesis: LASSS increases HGF receptor affinity and prevents nitration-induced dysfunction
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; LASSS enhances c-met binding affinity and confers nitration resistance through mechanism independent of antioxidative function

title: PHKA2-AS1 promotes leukemic proliferation and is associated with poor prognosis in acute myeloid leukemia
task: Determine the clinical relevance and biological effects of lncRNA PHKA2-AS1 in acute myeloid leukemia
key_results: PHKA2-AS1 upregulated in AML; overexpression promotes MV4-11 cell proliferation and G1/S transition; higher PHKA2-AS1 expression associated with poorer overall survival in TCGA-LAML; weak-to-moderate correlations with MCOLN1 and mitochondrial stress genes (BID, CASP9, PINK1)
comments: While the lncRNA shows prognostic associations, the mechanistic link to lysosome-mitochondria stress remains exploratory and lacks external validation of the proposed prognostic signature.

model_io.model: AML cell lines (MV4-11) and TCGA-LAML cohort

hypotheses.hypothesis: PHKA2-AS1 overexpression promotes AML cell proliferation
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; PHKA2-AS1 overexpression promotes MV4-11 proliferation and facilitates G1/S transition

hypotheses.hypothesis: PHKA2-AS1 acts through lysosome-mitochondria stress pathways in AML
hypotheses.result: Partially confirmed; co-expression correlations with MCOLN1 and mitochondrial stress genes observed but causality not established; mechanism requires further investigation

title: Sodium-glucose cotransporter 2 inhibitor tofogliflozin ameliorates insulin signaling by improving mitochondrial function in the podocytes in DKD
task: Determine how SGLT2 inhibitor tofogliflozin restores mitochondrial function and insulin signaling in diabetic podocytes
key_results: High glucose decreases mitophagy markers (PINK1) and mitochondrial membrane potential; tofogliflozin restores PINK1, BNIP3, and PGC1α expression and MitoMP; tofogliflozin partially reverses high glucose-induced IRS1 and Akt dephosphorylation
comments: The demonstration that SGLT2 inhibition improves mitochondrial dynamics and insulin signaling provides mechanistic support for therapeutic benefit in diabetic kidney disease.

model_io.model: Primary podocytes cultured in low vs. high glucose

hypotheses.hypothesis: High glucose impairs mitochondrial function and insulin signaling in podocytes
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; high glucose decreases mitophagy markers, membrane potential, and insulin receptor signaling

hypotheses.hypothesis: Tofogliflozin restores mitochondrial function through improved mitophagy and biogenesis
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; tofogliflozin increases PINK1, BNIP3, PGC1α expression and restores mitochondrial membrane potential

title: LSD1 is upregulated in angiotensin II-induced atrial remodeling and regulates oxidative stress, inflammatory signaling, and NLRP3 inflammasome activation associated with atrial fibrillation susceptibility
task: Determine the role of LSD1 in angiotensin II-induced atrial remodeling and atrial fibrillation susceptibility
key_results: Ang II increases LSD1 expression in atrial tissue and cardiomyocytes; LSD1 silencing attenuates Wnt/β-catenin signaling, reduces oxidative stress and inflammatory responses, and inhibits NLRP3 inflammasome activation
comments: The identification of LSD1 as an upstream epigenetic regulator of both hypertrophic and inflammatory pathways suggests it may be a critical node for AF prevention.

model_io.model: Ang II-infused C57BL/6 mice and HL-1 cardiomyocytes

hypotheses.hypothesis: LSD1 promotes Ang II-induced atrial remodeling through independent Wnt/β-catenin and oxidative stress pathways
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; LSD1 silencing reduces both Wnt/β-catenin signaling and oxidative stress-driven NLRP3 activation

key_results: Two-sensor system (pelvis + right hand) classifies 12 activities with 89.3% accuracy; five-sensor approach classifies all 14 activities at 88.2%; sensor placement critical; one-sensor insufficient
comments: Pragmatic sensor trade-off study enabling scalable activity monitoring; minimal sensor set practical for widespread deployment in aging-in-place applications.

inputs: accelerometer and gyroscope signals from 1, 2, or 5 wearable sensors

hypotheses.hypothesis: Two-sensor placement (pelvis + right hand) provides optimal accuracy-practicality trade-off
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; 89.3% accuracy with minimal sensors

hypotheses.hypothesis: Sensor placement more important than number for activity recognition
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; two well-placed sensors outperform one at any location

title: How to quantify an examination? Evidence from physics examinations via complex networks
task: Quantify examination structure via knowledge point networks and topological analysis
key_results: Physics exam KPNs exhibit scale-free, small-world, and assortative properties; communities and key nodes (mechanics, electromagnetism) identified; comprehensive difficulty coefficient correlates with network topological quantities
comments: Novel application of network analysis to curriculum design; topological metrics offer objective examination characterization, enabling data-driven educational policy.

inputs: examination questions and constituent knowledge points
outputs: graph with knowledge points as nodes, co-occurrence links as edges
degree, centrality, community membership, difficulty coefficient

hypotheses.hypothesis: Physics exam KPNs exhibit scale-free and small-world network properties
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; topological quantities reveal consistent structure across 35 exams

hypotheses.hypothesis: Network topology correlates with examination difficulty
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; comprehensive difficulty coefficient based on degree, density, clustering, transitivity

title: From courts to capital: how bankruptcy judicial reform affects corporate investment efficiency
task: Assess bankruptcy judicial reform impact on corporate investment efficiency
key_results: Non-optimal investment efficiency decreased 7.5% post-reform, primarily driven by 9.7% reduction in underinvestment; effect stronger in SOEs and competitive sectors
comments: Rigorous quasi-natural experiment design; staggered DID identifies clear causal mechanisms through improved financing and governance.

outputs: treatment effect estimates on investment efficiency

hypotheses.hypothesis: Bankruptcy court establishment improves corporate investment efficiency
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; 7.5% reduction in non-optimal investment

hypotheses.hypothesis: Effect operates through improved financing expectations and governance
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; underinvestment reduction primary driver

title: Capable language models can outgrow the benefits of collaboration
task: Predict when multi-agent LLM coordination improves performance
key_results: Single-agent baseline performance predicts coordination effect; empirical capability-saturation threshold beyond which additional agents degrade performance; threshold predicts outcome in 94% of validation configs; fitted model achieves cross-validated R² = 0.373 and selects best architecture in 87% of cases
comments: Rigorous empirical framework with practical architecture selection rule; capability-saturation threshold operationalizable for within-domain design decisions.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Single-agent baseline performance robustly predicts coordination benefit
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; emerges as most robust predictor across benchmarks

hypotheses.hypothesis: Capability-saturation threshold exists beyond which additional agents add overhead
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; threshold predicts effect in 94% of validation cases

title: Scientific productivity as a random walk
task: Model scientific productivity trajectories as random walks
key_results: Random walk model reproduces canonical trajectory via decreasing variance in early-career changes; captures diversity of individual trajectories and explains lognormal distribution of cumulative productivity; threshold predicts multi-agent coordination effects in 94% of cases
comments: Elegant resolution of long-standing puzzle in productivity patterns; simple variance-based mechanism explains both aggregate patterns and heterogeneity; generalization across 12 fields strengthens claims.

outputs: career trajectory distributions and cumulative productivity

hypotheses.hypothesis: Canonical trajectory emerges from decreasing variance in early-career changes, not directional drift
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; random walk variance structure explains aggregate patterns

hypotheses.hypothesis: Variance structure explains both canonical average and diversity of individual trajectories
hypotheses.result: Confirmed across 2085 computer science and 22,952 multidisciplinary faculty

title: Finite-temperature toroidal moment amenable to direct observation in an Fe10Dy10 molecular ring
task: Direct observation of finite-temperature toroidal moment in Fe10Dy10 molecular ring via preparation-readout protocol
key_results: Fe10Dy10 hosts 62-billion-dimensional low-energy manifold with strong toroidal response; finite-temperature toroidal susceptibility ξ is robust; preparation-readout protocol converts toroidal polarization to measurable electric-field-induced signal
comments: Transfer-matrix framework tractably handles enormous manifold dimension, but experimental realization of the proposed protocol remains to be demonstrated.

model_io.model: Fe10Dy10 molecular ring with ab initio-informed transfer matrix

hypotheses.hypothesis: Toroidal polarization in Fe10Dy10 can be prepared, accumulated, and read out under realistic conditions
hypotheses.result: Proposed protocol demonstrated theoretically; finite-temperature robustness confirmed via transfer-matrix calculations

title: Ground-based radar unveils natural electron Bernstein waves in the ionosphere of Earth
task: Direct detection of natural electron Bernstein waves in Earth's ionosphere using ground-based radar
key_results: First detection of naturally excited electron Bernstein wave harmonics (first seven gyroharmonics) via high-resolution spectral observations; enables retrieval of electron density and perpendicular electron temperature
comments: Remarkable observational achievement; EBW diagnostics provide complementary plasma measurements to ion line techniques, especially under geometrically constrained conditions.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Naturally excited electron Bernstein waves can be detected via ground-based radar in near-perpendicular magnetic geometry
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; seven discrete gyroharmonic lines detected; suprathermal photoelectrons and reduced Landau damping enable observation

title: Microwave-field quantum metrology with inherent robustness against detection losses enabled by Rydberg interactions
task: Quantum metrology of microwave fields using Rydberg atoms with inherent loss robustness
key_results: Single-shot precision of (217±8) μV cm^-1 for 160-ns microwave pulses; threefold enhancement of Fisher information via error-prevention protocol
comments: Clever use of inherent dipolar interactions to create a protective channel demonstrates that lossy quantum dynamics can paradoxically improve metrology.

model_io.model: Rydberg atom ensemble with dipolar interactions

hypotheses.hypothesis: Introducing lossy quantum channels can enhance quantum sensing robustness
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; threefold improvement in Fisher information through error-prevention protocol based on non-linear lossy dynamics

title: Teaching a transformer to think like a chemist: predicting nanocluster stability
task: Predicting nanocluster stability and dopant preference using transformer models pretrained on quantum cluster database
key_results: Mean absolute error of 0.6–0.7 eV for formation energy prediction; rapid adaptation to unseen Fe-host domain with few labeled examples; attention patterns identify size mismatch and d-electron count as key descriptors
comments: FAIR/TRUE principles ensure reproducibility, and transfer learning approach is pragmatic for exploring new nanocluster chemistries, though experimental validation is lacking.

model_io.model: Transformer architecture pretrained on Quantum Cluster Database

hypotheses.hypothesis: Transformer models can predict nanocluster stability and dopant segregation from DFT training data
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; transformer achieves 0.6–0.7 eV MAE and identifies size mismatch and d-electron count as key descriptors via attention

hypotheses.hypothesis: Model trained on unary clusters transfers to unseen bimetallic compositions
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; model rapidly adapts to Fe-host domain with minimal fine-tuning

title: A hybrid Anyon-otto thermal machine
task: Engineering quantum thermodynamic advantage in a hybrid anyon-Otto thermal machine via interaction-enhanced statistics
key_results: Low-temperature work maximized at intermediate anyon statistical angles (not bosonic or pseudo-fermionic limits); weak interactions enhance performance; interacting anyons outperform both bosons and fermions in extracted work
comments: Interesting synergy between exotic statistics and interactions, but experimental protocol using ultracold atoms is outlined without concrete feasibility assessment.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Anyonic statistics and interactions conspire non-trivially to enhance quantum thermodynamic performance
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; work output peaks at intermediate statistical angles with weak interactions, exceeding bosonic/fermionic limits

title: Coupling of topological interface states in one-dimensional photonic crystals is controlled by spatial distance and cap-layer symmetry, dictating the coupling quality
task: Engineering coupled topological interface states in 1D photonic crystals via spatial separation and cap-layer symmetry
key_results: Mode hybridization with near-unity transmission achieved with identical cap layers; Lorentzian transmittance dependence on refractive index mismatch; robust to fabrication thickness variations
comments: Comprehensive tolerance analysis and sensing applications are well-motivated, though experimental demonstration on actual fabricated structures is absent.

model_io.model: Triple-photonic-crystal structure with controllable cap layers

hypotheses.hypothesis: Coupling of topological interface states is controlled by spatial distance and cap-layer spectral alignment
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; perfect spectral alignment (identical cap layers) maximizes transmission; detuning suppresses coupling efficiency

title: Interplay of quasi-quantum Hall effect and Coulomb disorder in semimetals
task: Revealing quasi-quantum Hall effect in Dirac semimetals under disorder
key_results: Ultralow carrier densities (~10^16 cm^-3) in Cd3As2 enable QQHE observation at modest fields; Coulomb disorder broadens Landau bands and limits clear QQHE signatures
comments: The work clarifies why QQHE observation in semimetals is challenging, emphasizing disorder as a fundamental limitation rather than an afterthought.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Coulomb disorder obscures QQHE in semimetals at low carrier densities
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; disorder broadens Landau bands and scatters carriers, suppressing QQHE visibility
